## What Lives In The Lab {#laboratory-map .section-title}

```{=html}
<div class="wh-book-grid wh-reveal">
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Work A System</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title">Hydrology, Geomorphology, and Water Quality</div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">Rivers, reservoirs, erosion, coastal processes, and contaminant transport turn methods into integrated environmental problems.</div>
  </article>
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Test A Sensor</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title">Radar and Geophysical Investigations</div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">SAR, InSAR, GRACE, and passive microwave chapters connect advanced sensing to specific modelling questions.</div>
  </article>
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Model A City</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title">Urban and Transportation Studies</div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">Urban climate, accessibility, demographic change, and network analysis show how the lab extends into cities and infrastructure.</div>
  </article>
  <article class="wh-book-card">
    <span class="wh-book-card__status">Push The Methods</span>
    <div class="wh-book-card__title">Inference and Data Assimilation</div>
    <div class="wh-book-card__desc">Bayesian methods, ensembles, Kalman filtering, and satellite assimilation push into the more technical side of model practice.</div>
  </article>
</div>
```
